split_rule: Temporal partition: Train M5-M7 (6,046 shots), Validation M8 (559 shots / 6,206 slices), Test M9 (507 shots / 17,498 slices). Training fractions are nested shot subsets (1 < 5 < 10 < 25 < 50 < 100%, seeds 20260825/20260827). Slice membership is recorded for each fraction; five fractions are evaluated in the paper.

phase_composition.train: All slices from the shot subset assigned to each training fraction; Validation slices are not training samples.

notes: Run manifests subset_run_real_{f}pct include the full Validation partition for validation windows; only Train rows are used for optimization.
